name: @metamynd/agentsafe-a2a-guard
description: Zero-dependency trustless governance for the A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol. The RECEIVING agent independently re-verifies a calling agent's signed MAGP envelope against the caller's own published policy — so a caller that ignores its own guard still cannot make your agent act.
